summary: Release candidate for the LLM settings bridge autostart fix is ready as source and Python package artifacts. The release preserves local-only defaults, avoids deployment, and includes verification/security evidence for the previous LLM bridge connection-refused failure.
install_and_run: From a prepared source checkout, run ./build.sh to launch the local web UI.
For deterministic smoke verification, run APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --smoke --no-open.
Open the web UI and click LLM 연결; /api/llm/providers now lazy-starts the bundled local bridge when it is down and then returns provider choices.
To use a real external model, save a provider API key in the LLM 연결 설정 dialog or provide the provider's documented environment variable, then set/confirm the active provider and model.
configuration: APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_AUTOSTART defaults to true for local loopback bridge URLs and can be set to 0/false/no/off to disable lazy start.
APPFORGE_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT controls the bounded bridge startup wait, default 15 seconds.
Remote bridge URLs are not managed automatically; start those services separately and point APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_URL at them.
migrations: No database, config-file, or provider-secret migration is required.
Existing llm_bridge config and environment-based provider keys remain compatible.
Existing build.sh bridge startup behavior remains available for APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge or APPFORGE_START_LLM_BRIDGE=1.

release_checks.evidence: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q and AppForge run_tests both passed 27 tests.
Outside the restricted sandbox, /api/llm/providers returned HTTP 200 and provider IDs after local bridge autostart.
Outside the restricted sandbox, build.sh --smoke --no-open reached /api/health and /.
AppForge run_build produced dist/openappforge-0.4.0.tar.gz and dist/openappforge-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl.
release_readiness passed with source_present, README.md, .gitignore, verification artifact, and security artifact checks.
secret_scan found no likely committed credentials.
bun run typecheck and bun test passed in llm_bridge.

known_issues: Network-enabled dependency audit was not run because network is disabled in this environment.
Setuptools emitted pre-existing license metadata deprecation warnings during package build.
Live external provider calls require real user API keys and were not attempted.
If llm_bridge/node_modules is absent, users must run bun install in llm_bridge; the settings request does not auto-install dependencies.
rollback: Revert appforge/llm_bridge_process.py, appforge/web.py, and tests/test_web.py to remove lazy bridge autostart.
Keep manual bridge startup path by running cd llm_bridge && bun run start before opening LLM 연결 설정.
Delete regenerated dist artifacts if a clean rebuild is desired, then rerun .venv/bin/python -m appforge tool run run_build --project . --input '{}'.
No runtime data migration rollback is required.
